description: I build full-stack web applications with the MERN stack—MongoDB, Express, React, and Node—focused on structure, performance, and great user experience.
aboutParagraphs: I'm a student developer passionate about turning ideas into reliable software. I care about readable code, solid API design, and interfaces that feel intentional.

I work in the MERN stack end to end: MongoDB for data, Express for APIs, React for the UI, and Node on the server. This portfolio API uses JSON files under data/ for zero-setup local runs—you can mirror the same routes with MongoDB in production.
When I'm not building, I'm learning new tools, contributing where I can, and refining how I structure projects.
